title: Product Manager (Analytics)
full_description:
Following ING’s strategic ambition to deliver a superior experience to its customers worldwide, the hubs network contributes to fostering efficiency and digitalization across ING. Providing concentrated expertise along with scalable and sustainable solutions, the hubs focus on straight-through processing, delivering automated services like software development, data management and retail operations.

ING Hubs Turkiye core capabilities, 𝐑𝐞𝐭𝐚𝐢𝐥 𝐀𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐲𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡, have us looking for data experts, developers and other professionals to get onboard in our Istanbul office located in Technopark, Vadistanbul.

ING Hubs Turkiye is looking for talents to join an international network of professionals. Building on an existing framework and shared mission, our up-and-coming team will bring its unique personality and skills set to provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities.
We value strong work ethics, knowledge sharing and flexibility in our way of working – it is both our promise to you and what we look for in new colleagues. Let’s meet!
ING Analytics is a new unit responsible for realizing this vision for ING, differentiating ING as a leader in data-driven organization, within the banking sector and beyond. The team consists of a number of Global Analytics Centre of Excellences around the bank’s key capabilities (such as Customer Intelligence, Risk Management, Pricing, Financial Crime) as well as strong coordination areas around data management, technology, customer journey, UX, as well as external partnerships.
Retail Banking Analytics
Retail Banking Analytics (RBA) specialises in delivering Analytics and AI products and solutions across the ING retail business. We work together with all retail business units to deliver on the ING retail banking strategy. Projects span across personalisation and CI, mortgages, consumer finance, pricing, and business banking.
RBA in ING Analytics is looking for a Product Manager. As a Product Manager you will originate and build data-driven algorithmic products in customer intelligence area. This is an entrepreneurial and global role in an innovative international team.
Bachelor’s with analytical background, preferably in a quantitative discipline Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, MIS, Statistics etc. (Master’s degree or PhD will be a plus),
Broad experience leading and delivering analytics use cases and products is amust
Previous experience and proven knowledge of working in corresponding area is a plus.
4+ years of relavant work experience
Excellent team member with an ability to clearly communicate at all levels of an organization in a collaborative and non-hierarchical environment
Excellent analytical skills and attention to details
Desire to use modern technologies as a disruptive influence,
Open-minded for new technologies.
Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Turkish
Manage the entire analytics product development in prioritised area(s) in RBA – from outlining the type of solution through implementation, interpretation of results and transferring capabilities to business units, understanding and enthusiasm for technology, advanced analytics and data science methods
Product discovery: identify (data) problems, prioritize idea backlog and design and execute experiments to determine what problems need solving, Potential to extend product area when further grow.
Manage data-driven products so that they generate significant value for ING and its customers, create value propositions, vision and product strategy
Good understanding of innovation and product management methodologies such as Lean, Agile and Design Thinking, ability to develop structured product concepts from abstract ideas and lead prototyping
Effective Communication: Work with a squad of Data Scientists and Engineers to discover the potential of a product idea, the user problem and validate and prototype Demonstrate thought leadership internally and externally
Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors
Flexibility & Adaptability: Knowledge of successful approaches, tools, and techniques for dealing with changes and adapting to a changing environment; ability to adapt as needed
Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations
Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis and the ability to determine the root cause of diverse problems and create alternative solutions that resolve the problems in the best interest of the business
What We Offer at ING Hubs Turkiye
At ING Hubs Turkiye, we believe that your work should be fulfilling in every way. We pay attention to even the smallest details to ensure that your experience is rewarding. Here’s what you can expect when you join our organization:
Be Yourself, Be an ING'er
Dynamic Environment:Work in an informal, vibrant atmosphere with innovative colleagues supporting your endeavors.
Innovation Culture:Share your innovative ideas while exploring PACE methodology with us.
Global Exposure:Participate in global projects and expand your career opportunities.
Communication & Celebrations:Enjoy various communication activities and celebrations that promote a friendly work environment.
Health Care:Your health matters; we offer a comprehensive health insurance package for you and your loved ones, including spouse and children.
Private Pension Plan:Secure your future dreams with our private pension plan.
If you want to do your thing and explore the life while working don’t miss this opportunity!
